frontend.scope: Complete package-lock graph, including development dependencies

backend.scope: Resolved Maven application dependencies, including test scope; plugins/JDK/OS/container/cloud excluded

limited_secret_scan.limitations: Four token/key patterns in current textual source/config only; no entropy, Git history, Office files or runtime secrets scan.

limitations: Not DAST, penetration testing, browser E2E, cloud TLS/IdP/rate-limit validation or approval for Production.
